# Space Craft

> Space Craft is a workplace design and build studio in Bengaluru, India. It plans, designs and fits out offices — workplace planning, interior design and build & fit-out — from the first brief to move-in.

Studio address: 18, Buddha Vihara Rd, Cox Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560005, India. Work is scoped project by project. Contact is through the enquiry forms on the site.

## Company

- [About Space Craft](https://www.withspacecraft.com/about-us/): Space Craft is a workplace design and build studio centred on a simple question: what does your team need from its space?
- [Why Space Craft](https://www.withspacecraft.com/why-space-craft/): A compelling space is more than a photograph. It should make the everyday work of your team feel considered. Workplace design and build by Space Craft.
- [How we work](https://www.withspacecraft.com/how-we-work/): An office project has many moving parts. Keep people, design and delivery connected from the beginning. Share the floor plan, headcount, working patterns and…
- [Space studies (workplace concepts)](https://www.withspacecraft.com/projects/): Explore three starting points for a workplace conversation. Space Craft is a workplace design and build studio in Bengaluru, India.

## Services

- [What we do (overview)](https://www.withspacecraft.com/services/): Workplace planning, interior design and build & fit-out from Space Craft — take one stage or the whole project, from brief to move-in.
- [Workplace planning](https://www.withspacecraft.com/services/workplace-planning/): Understand how your team works before deciding how your office should look. Planning turns opinions about space into a brief everyone can agree on.
- [Interior design](https://www.withspacecraft.com/services/interior-design/): Bring layout, light, colour and materials together around the way your workplace needs to feel and function — and document it so it can be priced and built.
- [Build & fit-out](https://www.withspacecraft.com/services/build-and-fit-out/): Turn an agreed design into a finished, working office — with one team responsible for scope, site, services and handover.
